decision.thesis: No entry. Account is flat, so there is nothing to manage and the only question is whether to open. Direction is not the problem: five categories agree on up. Trend is a clean daily and 4h uptrend on all five contracts (higher lows on every 4h bar since the 2026-09-16 low; 2026-09-21 has closed above the 09-19/09-20 consolidation high on BTC, ETH, BNB and SOL). Price action shows a decisive breakout in the 08:00-09:00 UTC hours and four hours of tight holding above the broken level rather than a rejection back into the range. Volume confirms on SOL in particular, with a 3.8x expansion on the breakout hour (790,114 against 206,989 the hour before) and a steady dry-up through the consolidation (338,049 -> 190,150 -> 172,500). Market context is a unified complex move led by BTC, up 4.9% to 7.6% on the day across all five, not a single-coin story, and third-party reporting for today describes BTC failing at an 82-83K resistance zone earlier in the session, a zone this move has since broken, which corroborates that the rally is real market movement and not a demo-host artifact. Derivatives are supportive rather than stretched: funding is at or below the 0.010% baseline everywhere despite the rally (BTC actually negative at -0.0036%, BNB exactly 0.0000%, XRP 0.0022%, ETH 0.0079%, SOL 0.0100%), with the next funding at 16:00 UTC, so longs are not crowded. The entry nevertheless fails on the two conditions that govern where the stop and the target may be placed. BTC, BNB and SOL are all trading at 60-day highs with no daily high anywhere above the current price in 60 days, so no structural target exists for any of them and any target would have to be invented at whatever number satisfies the 1.5 floor (SOL would need 121.30 against a 60-day high of 117.06 set today; BNB would need 802.99, or 815.74 on the honest stop, against a 60-day high of 785.00 excluding today). Inventing a target to clear the arithmetic is the same defect as choosing a stop to fit a position size, which the strategy prohibits. ETHUSDT is the only contract with a genuine level overhead, the 2771.00 60-day high of 2026-09-11, and it is the trade that was actually worked through: entry 2722.55 at a 2.4 bps spread, target 2771.00, and an honest stop at 2693.00, which sits beyond 2694.94, the low of the hour that followed the breakout, and beyond the 2700.00 round number and 09-19 daily high that define the setup. That gives 29.55 gross risk against 48.45 gross reward, and a net reward/risk of 1.34 after the 14 bps round-trip cost estimate (3.81), below the 1.5 floor. Tightening the stop to 2707.00 under the three-hour consolidation low of 2709.56 would clear the floor at 2.31, but that stop sits above the broken 2700 level, so a routine retest of the breakout would stop the position out while the thesis was still intact; it is a stop chosen for size, not for invalidation, and it is rejected on that basis. XRPUSDT fails differently and worse: it is trading at 1.4886 directly into the 1.4894 swing high of 2026-09-14, the nearest overhead daily level, and on an honest stop below the 1.4527 breakout level the net reward/risk to the next level at 1.5270 is 0.89. BTCUSDT is additionally excluded under the demo price artifact rule (see the artifacts recorded in the evidence). A short was considered and rejected outright: it would trade against a clean daily and 4h uptrend on the day of a 60-day-high breakout, with funding at or below baseline meaning there is no crowded long positioning to squeeze, and with nothing behind it but the observation that the move is extended. Extension is a reason to decline a long, not a reason to sell. LESSONS.md holds no lessons yet, so no lesson applied. The prior run's research note for the 12:00 slot does carry forward a warning that the complex is extended after a 5-8% day and that this argues for more selectivity on a long at these levels, and this decision is consistent with it: the setup was worked through on real structure rather than waved through on the strength of the trend.

evidence.observed: Breakout in the 08:00-09:00Z hours followed by four hours of holding above the broken level, not rejection. SOL held a 114.99-117.06 range with rising lows 114.99 -> 115.22 -> 115.89; ETH held 2709.56-2727.20 above the broken 2700.00; BNB made a new high at 794.67 on the 11:00Z bar and held 789.98-791.76. Direction: supports long. Constraint: the levels that define these setups (ETH 2700.00/2694.94, BNB 776.48, SOL 114.13) sit 1.1% to 2.4% below the current price, which is what pushes an honest stop outside the reward/risk floor.

SOLUSDT breakout hour 08:00Z traded 790,113.5 against 206,989.0 the prior hour, a 3.8x expansion, then dried up through the consolidation at 338,049.4 -> 190,150.4 -> 172,499.5. BTC expanded 1.5x (93,708.3 vs 62,107.2) and ETH 1.16x (2,345,923.4 vs 2,030,649.0), both then declining. XRPUSDT showed no expansion at all on its breakout hour (3,834,343,686.6 against 3,979,635,554.6 the hour before), so volume does not support the XRP long. Direction: supports long on SOL, neutral on XRP.

Funding at or below the 0.010% baseline on every contract despite a 4.9-7.6% day: BTCUSDT -0.0036% (a long would receive), BNBUSDT 0.0000%, XRPUSDT 0.0022%, ETHUSDT 0.0079%, SOLUSDT 0.0100%. Next funding 2026-09-21T16:00Z for all five, roughly 3.8 hours out; a long on ETH, SOL or XRP would pay a small amount, a long on BTC would receive. Open interest: BTC 413,960,222.59, ETH 11,743,103,548.74, BNB 27,700,370,438.50, SOL 2,976,995,978.52, XRP 15,597,257,993,420.1. Direction: no crowded long positioning to fade, so this argues against a short and mildly for a long; it is not on its own a reason to enter.

All five up together over 24h: XRP +7.57%, SOL +7.21%, BTC +5.74%, ETH +5.57%, BNB +4.93%. One complex-wide risk-on move led by BTC rather than five independent setups, consistent with the strategy's note that these five are five ways to express one view. Direction: supports long, rules out short. Also the reason only one position would be opened even if several qualified.

evidence.observed: Report published earlier in the session quotes BTC near 81,170 and identifies 82K-83K as the key near-term resistance and 80K-81K as first support; macro backdrop described as unchanged, with the US 2-year yield near 4.76%, Middle East tension and Brent near 104. The demo host now quotes BTC near 85,000, so the move has broken the resistance zone the report named. This corroborates that the rally is genuine market movement rather than a demo-host pricing defect. No scheduled macro or regulatory event was identified for the next 24 hours that would justify an entry, and no single headline was used as a reason to trade.

considered_and_rejected.long_ETHUSDT: Best candidate and the only one with a real level overhead. Entry 2722.55 (ask, spread 2.4 bps), structural stop 2693.00 beyond the 2694.94 post-breakout low and the broken 2700.00 level, target 2771.00 (60-day high, 2026-09-11). Gross risk 29.55, gross reward 48.45, round-trip cost estimate 3.81 at 14 bps; net reward/risk 1.34, below the 1.5 floor. Rejected. A 2707.00 stop under the 2709.56 consolidation low would give 2.31 but sits above the broken level, so a normal retest would stop out an intact thesis; that is a stop chosen for size and is prohibited.
considered_and_rejected.long_SOLUSDT: Strongest volume signature on the board (3.8x expansion then dry-up) and a clean 4h uptrend. Entry 116.67, honest stop 113.90 beyond the 114.13 breakout level, risk 2.77. Clearing 1.5 net would require a target at or above 121.30, but SOL is at a 60-day high and there is no daily high above the current price in 60 days, so that target has no structural basis and would be invented to satisfy the arithmetic. Rejected.
considered_and_rejected.long_BNBUSDT: Tightest spread on the board at about 1.0 bps and a new high at 794.67. Honest stop below the 776.48 daily breakout level gives 15.19 risk and would need a 815.74 target; even the shallow 783.50 stop below the intraday 784.94 level would need 802.99. The 60-day high excluding today is 785.00 and nothing sits above the current price, so again no structural target exists. Rejected.
considered_and_rejected.long_XRPUSDT: Strongest 24h mover at +7.57% but trading at 1.4886 directly into the 1.4894 swing high of 2026-09-14, the nearest overhead daily level, with no volume expansion on its breakout hour. Honest stop below the 1.4527 breakout level gives 0.0386 risk against 0.0384 reward to the next level at 1.5270, a net reward/risk of 0.89. Rejected.
considered_and_rejected.long_BTCUSDT: Excluded under the Demo Price Artifacts rule: two upside artifacts inside four hours, one of them in the bar currently in progress, leave the recent highs and the 24h high field unreadable. Exchange-side stop and take-profit orders on this account trigger on the mark price in the same environment, so a resting order could be hit by an artifact. Separately BTC is also at a 60-day high with no overhead daily structure. Rejected.
considered_and_rejected.short_any: Rejected outright. A short would trade against a clean daily and 4h uptrend on the day of a 60-day-high breakout across the whole complex, with volume confirming the move up and funding at or below baseline, meaning there is no crowded long positioning to squeeze. The only argument for it is that the move is extended, and extension is a reason to decline a long, not a reason to sell. The strategy sets the same two-independent-category bar for a short as for a long and that bar is not met in the down direction by any category.
